title: benchmark-schema-mutation 0.1.0 package report
abstract: Schema Mutation (benchmark-schema-mutation) is a public npm benchmark package in the benchmark-* family, version 0.1.0, status alpha. This report records what the package measures in its own words, its deterministic grader and its SDK, CLI, MCP and HTTP surfaces, and the offline validation the family data holds: a scripted good policy mean of 1 and a scripted bad policy mean of 0 over 60 tasks, from mock runs at seeds 1 and 2; it declares no public task-split seed. The review record shows 2 fix rounds, 2 defect classes with public locators, and 12 merged feature pull requests of which 11 were approved. It was not part of the preregistered trivial-policy check. No real-model scores are reported. Software concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23422412, family paper DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23428802.
comments: Generated per-package technical report for benchmark-schema-mutation 0.1.0; data from pooriaarab/benchmark-family-paper paper/data and cached package sources.
